contact_locations_closure_log.edge_case_description: User requests specific floor/suite number in corporate office building

contact_locations_closure_log.verified_fallback: Physical office visits and suite deliveries are coordinated via verified appointment through xicteksystems.com/contact.

contact_locations_closure_log.edge_case_description: Public holiday / emergency maintenance support hours inquiry

contact_locations_closure_log.resolution_strategy: Enforce GND-RULE-02 fallback: state public schedule absence, redirect emergency requests to form with ticket priority
contact_locations_closure_log.verified_fallback: Holiday coverage and emergency technical escalations are managed via direct ticket submission at xicteksystems.com/contact.

contact_locations_closure_log.edge_case_description: Ambiguous regional routing: 'Can I visit XICTEK in London or New York tomorrow?'

contact_locations_closure_log.edge_case_description: Job applicant requesting HR phone interview scheduling via general contact bot

contact_locations_closure_log.edge_case_description: Solicitation / vendor pitch submission via contact chat

contact_locations_closure_log.verified_fallback: Vendor and commercial partnership proposals should be submitted through our corporate contact portal at xicteksystems.com/contact.
